gen-gf-warnes-fs-supreme: Warnes stretches out, its tapered ink strokes all drawn without contrast. Supreme sets plain sans text in a dense, heavy-looking strip, so a small Warnes heading would lose its stretched swagger beside it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-cascadia-mono: Expressive and relaxed, Revalia strides across widely separated letters with an open-curved lowercase g. Cascadia Mono stands compact sans-serif letters like pins, and that tidy, stem-thick uniformity is the real hook.
gen-irish-grover-fs-public-sans: Irish Grover is fun and organic, with softly varied strokes. Public Sans is the trustworthy sans-serif underneath, hefty in the lowercase, and the two share a sturdy, grounded feel.
gen-megrim-general-sans: Megrim's angular strokes finish at one measured thickness, giving it a futuristic bite and a c opened like a bent paperclip. It earns its keep big and short, leaving General Sans the sans-serif rest.
gen-mystery-quest-manrope: Mystery Quest feels bookish and nostalgic, with open jaws on every curved stroke. Manrope is the approachable sans-serif below, bright at every curve, so let the heading take the larger size.
gen-press-start-2p-satoshi: Satoshi is plain sans with pen-like constant lines and a soaring x-height, sitting under Press Start 2P's far-apart letters. Retro fun on top, soft brush-like shifts against a steady pen.
gen-righteous-switzer: Bent steel rod, bowls filling the line: that's Righteous. Switzer, the sans-serif below, has tubular, wire-like letters and a tall waist line, echoing that rodlike build for a shared, wiry link.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-cascadia-mono: Compact and pin-straight, this sans-serif body bends its curves with stem-like thickness. Cascadia Mono sits beside Snowburst One's stencil bridges like neon tubing next to a cut sheet, one tidy and one loud.
gen-tourney-general-sans: General Sans reads smoothly, with a pen pressure that never wavers and an x-height filling the line. And Tourney, all wide tracking and bulky small letters, supplies the athletic punch that the body leaves to it.
gen-audiowide-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta reads wide-mouthed and open, its big x-height leaving tight room for ascenders. Audiowide does the futuristic talking, glyphs tiled with wide grout lines, while the sans-serif body does the quiet reading.
